stem: During inventory, a pharmacist estimates the contents of an opened bottle containing 1,200 Schedule IV tablets. What should change?

choices.text: Use the out-of-state prescription rule when its schedule, age, and verification conditions have not been checked.
Process another refill because an authorization written by the prescriber overrides schedule limits.
Treat the request as an insufficient-stock partial fill and use the 72-hour remainder rule.
Handle the drug or transaction as ordinary Massachusetts Schedule VI activity.
Use an exact count because the opened container holds more than 1,000 dosage units.

explanation.core_reasoning: Schedule II inventory requires an exact count or measure; Schedule III through V opened containers may generally be estimated unless the container holds more than 1,000 units. The pharmacy must use the exact trigger and deadline rather than borrowing a nearby controlled-substance rule.

choice_analysis.A: That choice belongs, if at all, to Out-of-state Schedule III through VI prescriptions; its trigger does not match this scenario.
choice_analysis.B: That choice belongs, if at all, to Federal Schedule III and IV refill limits; its trigger does not match this scenario.
choice_analysis.C: That choice belongs, if at all, to Schedule II partial fill caused by pharmacy inability; its trigger does not match this scenario.
choice_analysis.D: That choice belongs, if at all, to Massachusetts Schedule VI prescription-drug status; its trigger does not match this scenario.
choice_analysis.E: This applies Exact and estimated controlled-substance inventory counts: Schedule II inventory requires an exact count or measure; Schedule III through V opened containers may generally be estimated unless the container holds more than 1,000 units.

related_facts: Schedule II inventory requires an exact count or measure; Schedule III through V opened containers may generally be estimated unless the container holds more than 1,000 units.
explanation.mpje_trap: Applying insufficient stock to facts controlled by counting method.

reasoning_steps: Identify the trigger for Exact and estimated controlled-substance inventory counts
